ACT XII OF 2012
ACT XII OF 2012
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA APPRENTICESHIP
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012
An Act to amend the Apprenticeship
Ordinance, 1962
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa,
Extraordinary,
20th September,-2012]
No.PA/Khyber Pakhtunkhwa/Bill/2012/9095, dated 20-9-2012.--The
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Apprentisceship
(Amendment) Bill, 2012 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 7th September, 2012 and assented to by the
Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 16th September,
2012 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Apprenticeship
Ordinance, 1962 (Ordinance No. LVI of 1962), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title, extent and Commencement.---(1) This Act may
be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Apprenticeship
(Amendment) Act, 2012.
(2) It
extends to the whole of the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.

General Amendment in Ordinance No. LVI of 1962

2. General
Amendment in Ordinance No. LVI of 1962.---In the
Apprenticeship Ordinance, 1962 (Ordinance No. LVI of 1962), hereinafter
referred to as the said Ordinance, for the words "Federal
Government", and "Provincial Government", wherever occurring,
the word "Government" shall be substituted.

of section 3 of Ordinance No. LVI of 1962.---In

"3.

notification in the official Gazette, constitute in the prescribed manner, a
Provincial and other Regional Tripartite Advisory Committees to advise
Government and the competent authority on matters relating to apprenticeship,
as it may consider necessary.".
